material.acceptance_criteria: Every lobby refusal shows a plain sentence from moba_ui.json, and no hyphenated machine code is visible in the lobby status line.
material.description: scenarios/moba/panels.lua:780 appends LOBBY.error verbatim after TEXT.lobby.refusedWord, so the lobby status line reads 'refused: not-ready' or 'refused: not-host'. The codes are set in lobby_act (panels.lua:664 'not-ready', plus not-host, slot-taken, already-seated, ready-locked, unknown-hero, no-hero, bad-slot). moba_ui.json:172 holds the only localized refusal word, and no per-code sentence exists. Nielsen's error heuristic asks for plain-language recovery text.
material.resolution: Refusal status shows a plain sentence from moba_ui.json; no machine code is visible (e0f7fe38).
material.subject: Lobby refusals show raw error codes such as not-ready
material.witness: Live lobby at https://lanmower.github.io/oscraft/js/client/play.html. Pick of a bot-held hero refused: status line reads '9/10 ready (refused: another seat already has that hero)', a plain sentence with no hyphenated code. 1280x720 dispatch 1792894844090-5198-c99b0d330364a41e; 375x667 dispatch 1792894849357-5203-1b93a5e2305e5753. Static: all 14 codes L.error emits in origin panels.lua (already-seated, bad-slot, hero-held, match-started, no-hero, no-roster, nothing-to-fill, not-host, not-owner, not-ready, ready-locked, slot-taken, unknown-hero, world-loading) have a moba_ui.json refusals sentence. Start is disabled in this browser (worldReady never fires), so the Start-while-not-ready press could not be driven live.
material.witness_plan: Live lobby: press Start while a seat is not ready; the status line must contain a plain sentence and no code such as not-ready.

witness_request.note: Code fix published (e0f7fe38 and e7fccdb8 cleanup). Witness is live (Start while a seat is not ready shows a plain sentence). The Start button is disabled until all seats are ready, so the refusal needs the widget action path. Left pending for the live lobby witness.

note: Refusal status shows a plain sentence from moba_ui.json; no machine code is visible (e0f7fe38).
